usermeta.idiom: Map: choropleth with a lookup join (required map #3)
todo: Download the EPBC threatened species list and run scripts/prep_threatened.py (README, step 3).

The lookup joins on properties.name in your states file. Check what the state-name property is called (Natural Earth uses 'name'; ABS files use STE_NAME21 or similar) and make sure it matches the 'state' column in the CSV.
States with no marine species (e.g. ACT) come through as null; they are drawn in light grey via the 'invalid' colour below.
Note the data is 'indicative occurrence' per state, so counts overlap between states: a species can appear in several. Say so in the caption.
Consider adding offshore territories if your states file includes them.

title.text: Threatened marine species by state and territory
title.subtitle: Number of EPBC-listed threatened marine species with indicative occurrence in each jurisdiction. A species can count in more than one.
